trigger: Viewport, emulated-device, or hosted-browser evidence is used to support a stronger physical-device or branded-browser claim.
assertions: viewport dimensions remain layout evidence and never imply physical-device execution
user-agent, touch, screen, or device-descriptor emulation never changes evidenceExecutionKind to physicalDevice
hosted Chromium evidence may verify hosted Chromium without verifying iOS Safari
Playwright WebKit is not silently relabeled as branded Safari or physical iOS Safari
a physical-device claim requires device, OS, browser, immutable subject, and device-run identity
a real user observation may reject a stronger operational claim without erasing valid weaker-environment evidence
absence of a physical-device run yields UNKNOWN_NO_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_RUN rather than pass or fail
user acceptance remains separate from viewport, hosted-runtime, and physical-device states
